te: Meeting summary video · Proposed system for employment and career development of older people, 2027–2047
The future of Thailand's labour market in an ageing society considered
se: The meeting considered the future of Thailand's labour market and building people and jobs in an ageing society, leading to proposals on law, state policy, lead agencies and cooperation with the private sector
it: The future of Thailand's labour market and the employment system in an ageing society

te: A 4-dimension study framework, and thoughts on the retirement age
se: The meeting received the report of the working group studying the law on employing older persons and post-retirement workers, which proposed a 4-dimension study framework: value and outcomes, workforce readiness, labour market demand, and the design of measures. It proposed that setting the retirement age should take into account age, benefits and social norms, and that if there are enough jobs it would increase employment and national output
it: 4-dimension framework for studying the employment of older people, and the retirement age

se: The meeting considered the subcommittee's action plan for October 2026 to May 2027, whose main theme is promoting older workers in both the formal and informal sectors, such as reviewing the law on employing older persons in the formal sector, with activities including inviting those concerned, site visits, seminars to hear views, and reporting to the committee

te: Working group reports on 3 months of work and what comes next
se: The meeting received a progress report from the working group studying the law on employing older persons and post-retirement workers covering 3 months, including inviting state and private agencies to exchange views, a comparative study of Japan, Singapore and South Korea, and site visits to Chiang Mai and Lamphun. Next steps are a forum to hear views from all sectors, including older people, and proposals on incentives for employers, skills development and the protection of rights
it: Progress of the working group studying the law on employing older persons and post-retirement workers over 3 months

te: Schedule of the study visit to Chiang Mai and Lamphun
se: The meeting considered the schedule of a study visit to Chiang Mai and Lamphun Provinces on 19–21 August 2026, such as discussions with the Governor of Chiang Mai and visits to community enterprises working on product development and local skills
it: Schedule of the study visit to Chiang Mai and Lamphun Provinces (19–21 August 2026)

te: A professional association of HR practitioners heard on a proposed policy framework for retirement-age workers
se: The meeting studied the law on employing older persons, inviting a professional association of human resources practitioners to give information on its human resource development work and its proposed policy framework for retirement-age workers in Thailand, which calls for a concrete system to support work by older people, not just one-off projects
it: Proposed policy framework for retirement-age workers

te: Singapore's law on employing older persons, and its tripartite mechanism, studied
se: The meeting studied Singapore's laws and policies on employing older persons, hearing experts on matters such as the tripartite workgroup on older workers set up in 2019, which supported raising the retirement age to 65 and re-employment up to 70, and a policy framework of 7 pillars driven jointly by the state, employers and employees
it: Singapore's laws and policies on employing older persons

te: Department of Older Persons heard on the Older Persons Fund
se: The meeting considered approaches to labour development and laws for an ageing society, inviting the Department of Older Persons to give information on the Older Persons Fund under the Older Persons Act, such as interest-free loans for starting an occupation, repayable within 3 years, and support for the activities of older persons' groups and organisations
it: The Older Persons Fund and loans for starting an occupation

te: Summary of the Samut Songkhram and Prachuap Khiri Khan study visits on work for older persons
se: The meeting considered the draft summary of the study visit and seminar in Samut Songkhram and Prachuap Khiri Khan Provinces on 27–29 May 2026, such as a Sufficiency Economy learning centre practising integrated farming and processing of produce, to find ways to create jobs and income for older persons
it: Draft summary of the study visit and seminar, Samut Songkhram and Prachuap Khiri Khan Provinces

te: Working group proposes 5 measures for an ageing society and a shrinking workforce
se: The meeting noted the progress of the working group studying the law on employing older persons and post-retirement workers, which proposed 5 policy measures, such as lifelong skills development for Thai people, promoting employment at every age with flexible forms of work, building a national labour database, and raising productivity with technology and automation
it: The 5 policy proposals of the working group studying the law on employing older persons and post-retirement workers

te: Japan's experience in employing older persons studied
se: The meeting studied the employment of older persons and post-retirement workers, hearing the experience of representatives of companies in Japan in 3 areas: retirement age policy and law, organisational management for re-employing staff near retirement, and pay structures, for use in developing Thai law and policy
it: Employing older persons: the experience of Japan

te: Report planned in 12 task groups, seeing older persons as a resource rather than a burden
se: The meeting noted the plan of the working group studying the law on employing older persons and post-retirement workers, which divides the work into 12 task groups to change the view of older persons from a burden to a resource, study their economic value, build a database of older workers and match it with employers' needs, in 3 dimensions: value, labour supply and labour demand. It will go on to study the approaches of Japan and Singapore
it: Reporting plan of the working group studying the law on employing older persons and post-retirement workers (12 task groups)

te: Drafting begins on the report on labour development in an ageing society
se: The meeting considered the progress of the working group studying approaches to labour development in an ageing society, which presented the first chapters of its draft study report for consideration
it: Draft study report on approaches to labour development in an ageing society

te: Facts gathered on a complaint about the foreign workers' work permit system
se: As assigned by the committee, the meeting gathered facts on a complaint, as alleged, about the project hiring a private company to run the electronic system for work permits and work notifications of foreign workers. It invited the Department of Employment to clarify. The department explained that it had acted under the public procurement law, that the problems were likely caused by many users at the same time, and that it had already collected the fines under the contract. The meeting felt the problem concerned system use and management, and resolved that the complainant be informed of the facts gathered
it: Complaint about the electronic work permit system for foreign workers (e-Work Permit)

te: Summary of a study visit on cooperation in skills development for older workers
se: The meeting considered the draft summary of a study visit to a private technology company on 11 March 2026, which discussed the possibility of cooperation between the private sector and the committee in developing the skills of older workers
it: Draft summary of the study visit on skills development for older workers (11 March 2026)
